notes: Methodology profiles (plan X0 3.4; decisions Q1, Q2, Q3, Q12, Q14). Exactly one profile is the default for new Runs.

gated_corrections lists the profile_gated corrections a profile enables: "*" enables every profile_gated correction in corrections/*.json, [] enables none. Universal corrections apply to every profile.

supported_modules / supported_extensions / supported_data_packs / external_code_policy form the one combination whitelist (C16). A violation is VALUE_PROFILE_COMBINATION_UNSUPPORTED with a sub-reason (module, extension, data_pack, external_code, reference_path).

supported_modules maps a module id to the accepted scientific_version values. A package that changes a lineage module's scientific_version while keeping the doctoral behaviour behind a gated correction appends the new value here and updates the frozen-profile tripwire in tests/test_methodology_profiles.py in the same commit.

reference_configuration is the explicit preset of the frozen profile (Q3): it is written into the Study when the profile is chosen; a deviating value is allowed but recorded on the Run (reference_deviations).
result_publication (Q14): raw_invariants_must_pass withholds annual results from result pages unless the run's raw invariants all passed; Inspect and exports stay available.
Rule sets never compare profile ids (C15); they ask ResolvedMethodology.enabled(<correction id>).
